# Alali Homes

> Alali Homes Ltd is a guaranteed rent and corporate lettings company for landlords in London, the South East, the East of England, the South West, Wales, the Midlands, the North West, Yorkshire and the Humber, and the North East. It leases studios, 1 to 4+ bedroom houses and flats, HMOs of any size, blocks of flats and converted buildings on 3-5 year corporate leases, pays the landlord a fixed rent every month whether or not the property is occupied, and provides full property management and dedicated tenant support for the whole term.

## Key facts

- Company: Alali Homes Ltd, registered in England and Wales, company number 17095100, registered office 86-90 Paul Street, London EC2A 4NE.
- Contact: info@alalihomes.com, 020 4515 8438, or the enquiry form at https://www.alalihomes.com/#contact-form
- Service: guaranteed rent on a corporate lease (company let). Alali Homes Ltd is the landlord's tenant, so the landlord has one tenant, one monthly rent payment and one point of contact.
- Lease length: 3 to 5 years. Rent, term, break clause and notice periods are agreed in writing before the landlord signs.
- Guarantee: the agreed rent is paid every month for the full term regardless of occupancy. Voids and arrears are Alali Homes' risk, not the landlord's.
- Property types: studios and 1-bed flats, 2 and 3 bedroom houses and flats, 4+ bedroom family homes, licensed HMOs of any size, whole blocks of flats, and converted buildings such as former care homes, hotels and offices. The full range applies in every area.
- Included: full property management (maintenance and repairs coordination, regular inspections, compliance tracking), dedicated support for tenants, and the property professionally maintained throughout the lease and returned in the agreed condition, allowing for fair wear and tear.
- HMOs: taken on as licensed and managed in line with the licence conditions and HMO management regulations. Licence-holder and manager responsibilities are agreed in writing.
- Compliance: the owner remains legally responsible for certain safety certificates (gas safety, EICR, EPC); Alali Homes tracks renewals and arranges them where agreed.
- Every property is assessed individually and receives a written rent offer if it is a good fit.
- Agents: letting and estate agents can refer landlords and earn a referral fee, agreed in writing.

## Areas covered

- London: all 32 boroughs.
- South East: Kent (including Medway), Surrey, East Sussex, West Sussex, Hampshire and the Isle of Wight, Berkshire, Buckinghamshire (including Milton Keynes), Oxfordshire.
- East of England: Essex (including Southend-on-Sea and Thurrock), Hertfordshire, Bedfordshire (including Luton). Not Cambridgeshire, Norfolk or Suffolk.
- South West: Bristol, South Gloucestershire, Gloucestershire, Somerset, Bath and North East Somerset, North Somerset, Wiltshire and Swindon, Dorset and Bournemouth, Christchurch and Poole, Devon, Plymouth, Torbay, Cornwall and the Isles of Scilly.
- Wales: Blaenau Gwent, Bridgend, Caerphilly, Carmarthenshire, Ceredigion, Conwy, Flintshire, Gwynedd, Isle of Anglesey, Merthyr Tydfil, Monmouthshire, Neath Port Talbot, Pembrokeshire, Powys, Rhondda Cynon Taf, Torfaen, Vale of Glamorgan, Wrexham. Not Cardiff, Newport or Swansea.
- Midlands: all of the West Midlands and East Midlands.
- North West: Liverpool, Knowsley, St Helens, Wirral, Warrington, Halton, Cheshire East, Cheshire West and Chester, Preston, Chorley, South Ribble, Blackburn with Darwen, Burnley, Hyndburn, Pendle, Rossendale, Ribble Valley, Lancaster, Cumberland, Westmorland and Furness.
- Yorkshire and the Humber: Barnsley, Bradford, Calderdale, East Riding of Yorkshire, Hull, Kirklees, Leeds, North Lincolnshire, North Yorkshire, Rotherham, Sheffield, Wakefield, York.
- North East: Gateshead, Newcastle, South Tyneside.
